findings.title: Deleting cache does not invalidate connectedCalendars query, leaving stale cache status in UI
findings.body: `deleteCacheMutation` shows a toast and calls `onSuccess?.()`, but unlike `disconnectMutation` below it (lines 61-64), it never invalidates `utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`. In `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper`, `onChanged` is optional and the component relies on its internal `trpc.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.useQuery` for `cacheUpdatedAt`. After a user deletes the cache, the dropdown continues to show the old `cacheUpdatedAt` timestamp and the "Delete cached data" action until the page is manually refreshed. Add an `onSettled` handler on `deleteCacheMutation` that calls `await utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.invalidate()`.

findings.title: `updateMany({ data: {} })` does not update `SelectedCalendar.updatedAt`
findings.body: `SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {})` calls `prisma.selectedCalendar.updateMany({ where: { credentialId }, data: {} })`. In Prisma, `updateMany` with an empty `data` object does not automatically set `@updatedAt` columns (and may be a no-op), unlike single-record `update` or passing `updatedAt: new Date()` explicitly. If the intent is to bump `SelectedCalendar.updatedAt` for all rows under the credential, pass `{ updatedAt: new Date() }` (or remove this call if `CalendarCache.updatedAt` is the only timestamp used).

findings.title: Direct instantiation of `CalendarCacheRepository` bypasses the `calendar-cache` feature flag
findings.body: `connectedCalendarsHandler` instantiates `new CalendarCacheRepository()` directly instead of going through `CalendarCache.init(null)` (which returns `CalendarCacheRepositoryMock` when the `calendar-cache` feature is disabled, and is why `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` was also added to `CalendarCacheRepositoryMock` in this PR). Instantiating `CalendarCacheRepository` directly queries `prisma.calendarCache` even when the feature is disabled and leaves `CalendarCacheRepositoryMock.getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` unused.
